g.text: Zero-Trust Payroll Attendance: 18 Prisma Data Models, WebAuthn Passkeys, Anti-Cheat Dual Geofence (Haversine + WiFi IP), 15s QR Tokens & Ed25519 Audit Chain

svg.text: ZONE 1: PRISMA SCHEMA & DATABASE DOMAINS (18 ENTITIES)
ZONE 2: RUNTIME WORKFLOWS & ANTI-CHEAT SECURITY ENCLAVES
ZONE 3: PAYROLL FINALIZATION, ZERO-TRUST AUDIT & GOVERNANCE

g.text: SCHEME A: WEBAUTHN PASSKEY & HARDWARE DEVICE BINDING FLOW
Server creates challenge nonce with 5-minute TTL & user ID bound
Invokes Touch ID / Face ID hardware enclave (authenticatorAttachment: "platform")
Verifies clientDataJSON signature & extracts COSE public key bytes
Saves Base64URL credentialID, deviceName parsed from UA, counter: 0
Preserves active session token (payroll_auth_token) avoiding 401 unauth
HTTP 403 DEVICE_MISMATCH -> Generates 6-Digit Unlock Code -> Owner Approval Required
Hardware-bound private key never leaves the secure enclave; clones rejected via WebAuthn counter validation.
SCHEME B: 15s DYNAMIC QR KIOSK, FAST-POLL & QUEUE ANTI-COLLISION
Rotates token every 15s; auto-syncs dynamic office WAN IP from kiosk header
Polls every 1500ms; instantly rotates QR on screen when employee burns token
Captures challenge token via camera stream with soft facingMode constraints
Atomic DB write: isActive = false, consumedAt = now(), consumedBy = employeeId
Scanned within 4s of consumption in office -> HTTP 409 QR_QUEUE_ROTATING (no cheat alert)
Scanned > 4s or out-of-bounds -> HTTP 409 QR_ALREADY_USED + Flags CHEATING_ALERT
SCHEME C: ANTI-CHEAT DUAL LOCATION VERIFICATION & CHECK-OUT TELEMETRY
Acquires high-accuracy GPS coordinates (lat, lng, accuracy) & WAN IP from request headers
Computes spherical distance (d = 2R * asin(sqrt(...))) between scanner & OfficeConfig
If distanceMeters > radiusMeters (50m) -> HTTP 403 GEO_OUT_OF_BOUNDS + Audit Cheating Alert
If enforceWifiIp: compares client WAN IP with OfficeConfig.officePublicIp
If check-out attempted < 60s after check-in -> HTTP 429 SCAN_COOLDOWN_ACTIVE (token spared)
Persists checkIn* and checkOut* (Latitude, Longitude, Distance, IP) in AttendanceRecord
SCHEME D: SHIFT EVALUATION, OVERNIGHT BINDING & LATENESS CALCULATION
For overnight shifts (e.g. 22:00 - 06:00), binds check-in and next-day check-out to shiftDate
If punchTime <= graceDeadline: lateMinutes = 0, status = "CHECKED_IN", netDaily = dailySalary
Evaluates DeductionPolicy: PER_MINUTE (lateMinutes * rate) or PER_HOUR (rounded hours * rate)
Deduction is strictly capped at (dailySalary * maxDeductionPercent / 100); netDaily >= 0
Stores dailySalarySnapshot and deductionPolicySnapshot directly in AttendanceRecord row
SCHEME E: OWNER REAL-TIME ANALYTICS & ATTENDANCE BREAKDOWN (HADIR/TELAT/ALPA)
Accepts query range: 7d, 14d, 30d, or current_period; verifies OWNER authorization
Checks employeeProfile.joinedAt & shift.applicableDays (0-6) for each calendar day
absentCount = assignedShiftCount - presentCount (no manual alpa entry needed)
Renders dynamic Hadir (green), Terlambat (amber), Alpa (rose) bar chart with dark/light themes
Lists employee punctuality rates, total late minutes, accrued daily wages, and raw audit logs
SCHEME F: IMMUTABLE MONTHLY PAYROLL FINALIZATION & SNAPSHOT FREEZE
Queries all finalized AttendanceRecords + approved PayrollAdjustments for billing month
grossEarnings = completedDays * dailySalary; netEarnings = gross - lateDeductions + adjustments
Owner inspects breakdowns, adds one-time bonuses or deductions (PayrollAdjustment)
Sets PayrollPeriod.status = "FINALIZED", finalizedAt = now(), isFinalized = true
Modifying EmployeeProfile.dailySalary afterward NEVER changes finalized PayrollRecord
Creates tamper-proof AuditLog: PAYROLL_PERIOD_FINALIZED with cryptographic sequence
SCHEME G: ZERO-TRUST Ed25519 CRYPTOGRAPHIC AUDIT CHAIN & OUTBOX
Serializes actor, action, targetEntity, previousValues, newValues via deterministic JSON
Signs currentHash using AUDIT_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY; verifiable with public key
Strict sequenceNumber increment enforced; gaps immediately indicate deleted records
prevent_audit_log_update trigger blocks all UPDATE and DELETE queries at DB level
Inserts PENDING outbox item in same ACID transaction for reliable log forwarding
Delivers outbox logs to secondary cold storage; retries with exponential backoff
SCHEME H: OWNER UNILATERAL DEVICE REVOCATION & REAL-TIME CONTROLS
Displays all enrolled employee hardware passkeys, device names, and assurance tiers
Owner can immediately disconnect any compromised employee terminal with a single click
Sets DeviceRegistration.isActive = false, status = "REVOKED", purges active Sessions
Next employee request receives HTTP 401/403, forcing device re-registration
Interactive map / input on /owner/settings updates OfficeConfig coordinates & WiFi IP
